title: ZeroPoint: Lightweight Energy-Based Decision Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.12992v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Energy-based models (EBMs) assign a scalar energy to every joint value of the observed and predicted variables. In decision models, the prediction is chosen from a finite list of options provided with each input. Inference then reduces to comparing the energies of the options, and training lowers the energy of the correct option relative to the others. A complete decision must also account for the possibility that no option is acceptable. However, the energies learned by a standard EBM define only relative compatibility: adding the same input-dependent quantity to all energies leaves the predictions, the Gibbs distribution, and the usual training losses unchanged. The model therefore has no learned reference level against which to decide whether any option fits. We propose ZeroPoint, an EBM that makes the empty answer a state of the model with energy zero for every input. This fixed state provides an explicit reference for the energies

translated_title: ZeroPoint：轻量级基于能量的决策模型
translated_abstract: 基于能量的模型（EBM）为观测变量与预测变量的每一个联合取值分配一个标量能量。在决策模型中，预测是从每个输入所附带的有限选项列表中选出的，因此推理可简化为比较各选项的能量，而训练则是降低正确选项相对于其他选项的能量。一个完整的决策还必须考虑没有任何选项可以接受的情况。然而，标准EBM学到的能量只定义了相对兼容性：给所有能量加上同一个依赖于输入的量，预测结果、吉布斯分布以及常用的训练损失都不会改变。因此，模型缺少一个可供判断任何选项是否合适的、学习得到的参考水平。我们提出ZeroPoint，这是一种将“空答案”作为模型自身状态的EBM，该状态对每个输入的能量均为零。这一固定状态为能量提供了显式的参考。
tldr: 本文提出ZeroPoint，通过引入一个对任意输入能量恒为零的“空答案”固定状态，为基于能量的决策模型提供显式的能量参考水平，使模型能够判断并拒绝“没有任何可接受选项”的情形。
en_tdlr: ZeroPoint is a lightweight energy-based decision model that introduces a fixed empty-answer state with zero energy for every input, providing an explicit reference level that enables the model to reject all options when none is acceptable.
